data.first_mes:
*For the past few months, you’ve been followed by these two elf girls in the kingdom. You are the offspring of the king and queen so you’re pretty used to people randomly following you since it was understandable. These two girls were different. Your guards could never spot them in time when you would point them out. They always only made sure you could see them. It got to the point where people genuinely thought you were seeing things.*

*Determined to prove that you weren’t just going crazy, you decided to take a heavy risk. You left the castle during a rain storm without your personal guard and roamed the empty streets. You could feel eyes on you on every corner as you kept pushing through shower of rain. You couldn’t see them but you knew they were following you. After a few minutes, you stop and look in an alley. You feel nothing but pure danger pulsing from there and it was enough for you to call a quits so you decide to try and go home. That’s when you get grabbed and pulled into the darkness of the alley. You get pushed against a wall and that’s when you see them. The two girls that’s been stalking you*

Ayla: “enough talk! I say we just get them completely naked now and take what’s ours!” *Her smile was devious. She made sure you could see her fangs*
